intro.title: R-BMS score server
intro.description: R-BMS is a BMS player. This site is the online ranking server that the player submits scores to, and you can browse the submitted records and difficulty tables here.

highlights.scores: Scores and lamps for the charts you play accumulate on your account, and every chart has its own ranking.
highlights.rivals: Register rivals and compare with them right in the in-game ranking panel.
highlights.sync: Upload your settings and key layout to the server and download them on another device.

guide.intro: The R-BMS player lets you finish the whole IR setup inside the game. On the song select screen, press Tab to open SETTINGS and go to the NETWORK tab to set the server address, account, sync, and rivals.

connect.title: 1. Connect to the server
connect.body: On the song select screen, press Tab to open SETTINGS. Choose NETWORK among the tabs at the top, then press Enter or the right arrow key on the SERVER URL row to type the address in place. Press Enter to confirm or Esc to cancel. If you leave the address empty, the game runs offline.

steps.open: On the song select screen: Tab → SETTINGS
steps.network: Select the NETWORK tab with Tab (PLAY · GAUGE · JUDGE · DISPLAY · INPUT · NETWORK)
steps.server: On the SERVER URL row: Enter → type {url} → Enter
steps.player: Enter your account ID on the PLAYER ID row (default: guest)
steps.close: Closing SETTINGS with Esc saves the changes

account.title: 2. Account
account.body: Fill in the EMAIL and PASSWORD rows on the NETWORK tab, then sign up with REGISTER or sign in with LOGIN. PASSWORD is shown only as * while you type, is never saved to the settings file, and is wiped from memory as soon as a login or sign-up has used it. On success, the token and login ID are saved in the local settings and PLAYER ID is set to the login ID the server returned.

playerId.label: PLAYER ID
playerId.description: The login ID of your server account and the identifier shown in rankings. LOGIN and REGISTER use this value as the ID.

email.label: EMAIL
email.description: Used only by REGISTER. It is not used to authenticate logins.

password.label: PASSWORD
password.description: Masked input that is never saved. It shows (not set) when empty.

login.label: LOGIN
login.description: Signs in in the background with PLAYER ID + PASSWORD. On success it goes on to save the token, rebuild the score server connection, and refresh the rival list.

register.label: REGISTER
register.description: Signs up with PLAYER ID · EMAIL · PASSWORD. What happens after success is the same as LOGIN.

logout.label: LOGOUT
logout.description: Clears the token, the login ID, and any password kept in memory. PLAYER ID stays, so signing in again takes a single input.

account.label: ACCOUNT
account.description: A read-only row that shows the current state, such as guest / logging in... / logged in as '<id>' / login failed: '<error>' / session expired: '<error>'.

ranked.title: 3. Ranked play
ranked.body: When a play ends, the IR result appears on the left of the result screen. If the server accepts it, you see IR: RANK #'<rank>' or IR: SENT, and NEW BEST appears too when you beat your personal best. Plays that meet the conditions below either skip submission or are recorded as UNRANKED and drop out of the ranking. A play made by a person is stored on the server even with assist options, and the same goes for courses. Only SCRATCH AUTO plays enter the ranking but are counted separately.

skipped.label: autoplay · replay playback
skipped.description: These are not recorded, so nothing is submitted. The result screen shows IR: SKIPPED (autoplay) or IR: SKIPPED (replay playback).

widenedJudge.label: Widened judge window
widenedJudge.description: A play with JUDGE WIDTH or the LN margin set wider than 100 is submitted and recorded, but excluded from the ranking and the server best (UNRANKED: widened judge or assist options). A course containing even one such stage is treated the same way.

scratchAuto.label: SCRATCH AUTO
scratchAuto.description: A play made with SCRATCH AUTO is submitted with the turntable notes left out of judgement and does enter the ranking. The server keeps the best normal play and the best SCRATCH AUTO play separately. The web ranking list has "Include SCRATCH AUTO" turned on by default, so for each player it shows the higher of the normal and SCRATCH AUTO records with an A-SCR marker; turning "Include SCRATCH AUTO" off shows normal plays only. The rank on the result screen is based on the list the play belongs to, so it appears as IR: RANK #'<rank>' (SCRATCH AUTO). The song select ranking panel uses the list of normal plays only. A course containing even one SCRATCH AUTO stage is treated the same way. A play that also uses a widened judge window is UNRANKED because of the widened judge window.

assist.label: Assist options · guest submissions
assist.description: Even when the server accepts a play, it may exclude it from the ranking. In that case the reason the server reports is shown as is, for example UNRANKED: assist options, guest submission.

ranked.code:
IR: RANK #12
NEW BEST
REPLAY UPLOADED

rankingPanel.title: 4. Song select ranking panel (IR RANKING)
rankingPanel.body: On the song select screen, press I to open the IR RANKING panel on the right and move focus to it. Move between rows with up/down, play a replay with Enter, and close the panel with I, Esc, or the left arrow key. When the focused chart stays selected for a moment, the top 10 players, your best, rival records, and the replay list are fetched together and cached per chart.

layout.label: Row layout
layout.description: Each row shows rank · player name · EX score · clear lamp in that order. F'<fast>'/S'<slow>' is added on the right when the server provides judgement details, and REP when a downloadable replay exists.

youRival.label: YOU · RIVAL rows
youRival.description: Below the ranking comes a YOU row with your best, followed by RIVAL '<player ID>' rows. If there is no record, the rank and score are shown as -.

replay.label: REP playback
replay.description: Press Enter on a row marked REP to download and play the replay right away. On a row without a replay, no replay for that row is shown.

status.label: Status messages
status.description: One of IR OFF - SET SERVER URL IN SETTINGS · SELECT A CHART · LOADING... · NO SCORES YET · ERROR: '<error>' is shown on a single line.

replay.title: 5. Replay upload
replay.body: With AUTO UPLOAD REPLAY on the NETWORK tab set to ON (the default), the replay is uploaded along with the score when the score is accepted normally and nothing excludes it from the ranking. The result screen shows REPLAY UPLOADED or REPLAY ERROR: '<error>'. Anyone can download and play an uploaded replay from the REP row in the ranking panel.

autoUpload.label: AUTO UPLOAD REPLAY
autoUpload.description: Switch ON / OFF with the left/right arrow keys, Enter, or a click; the change is saved immediately.

condition.label: Upload conditions
condition.description: You must be signed in, the play must actually have saved a replay, and the score must be accepted without a ranking-exclusion flag.

sync.title: 6. Settings sync
sync.body: With SYNC SETTINGS set to ON (the default is OFF), your play settings and key layout can be kept on the server. Upload the current settings with UPLOAD SETTINGS NOW and download and apply them with DOWNLOAD SETTINGS NOW. If something was uploaded earlier from another device, conflict: server newer, download first is shown, so download first and then upload again.

uploaded.label: What is uploaded
uploaded.description: Your play settings and key layout. The token, login ID, email, and password are never uploaded.

downloaded.label: When downloading
downloaded.description: Only the play settings and key layout are overwritten. Per-device values such as SERVER URL, PLAYER ID, song folders, and font paths stay as they are.

requirement.label: Requirements
requirement.description: SERVER URL must be set and you must be signed in. Otherwise set SERVER URL first or log in first is shown on the status line.

rivals.title: 7. Rivals
rivals.body: Press Enter on the RIVALS row at the bottom of the NETWORK tab to open the rival list. Press Enter on the + ADD RIVAL (PLAYER ID) row to enter the PLAYER ID of the other player, and press D to delete the selected rival. Closing with Esc saves the list to the settings file and, if you are signed in, applies the whole list to the server too.

controls.label: Controls
controls.description: UP DOWN move · ENTER add · D delete · ESC save and close. Empty and duplicate IDs are ignored.

sync.label: Sync
sync.description: The list is refreshed from the server right after you log in or sign up, and at startup when a saved token exists.

display.label: Display
display.description: Registered rivals are shown in the song select ranking panel as RIVAL '<player ID>' rows.

apiToken.title: 8. API token for other tools (Advanced)
apiToken.body: The game client needs nothing more than LOGIN above. To call this IR from your own scripts or external tools, issue a token on the API token tab of the web settings screen and send it in the Authorization header. The plain-text token is shown only once, right after it is issued, so save it on the spot, and revoke tokens you no longer need from the list.

cliOverrides.title: 9. Overriding launch arguments (Advanced)
cliOverrides.body: You normally do not need this. When you want to change values for a single run after the saved settings have been applied, you can override the server address and player ID with --server and --player.
